tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind cards. A quiet neutral so white cards and the AI layer stand out.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, inputs and the navigation surface. Set apart from bg by line and shadow-card.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: text areas, stepper buttons, track behind a bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Decorative: it is below 3:1, so inputs also rely on their label and the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary actions, active states, links and icons on surface. Bright green in dark mode, so pair a fill with on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, product art, the selected navigation row. Text on it is accent or ink.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Success text on good-soft and surface. Always with a word.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Success pill fill.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text on warn-soft and surface. Also the number on a stat that needs action.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warning pill fill.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Danger text on bad-soft and surface, and count badges.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Danger pill fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: In-progress status text, such as On the way, on info-soft and surface.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: In-progress status fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the More sheet.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Business name in the home hero.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Nothing is sent until you confirm.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, buttons at small size, form labels.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Bottom bar and service tile labels.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Order, invoice and SKU codes only.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tight stacks inside a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button groups, chip rows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Inner padding of tiles.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Card padding and phone page side padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Laptop page padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Stepper controls and small inner fills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, product art.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Service tile icon square.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The services card and app frame.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, search bar, segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards: borders do the separating, the shadow only lifts them off the canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus and pop-ups that float above the page.
